sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Bhubaneswar
sources.note: City overview and destination list, including Mukteswar, the Jain caves and Dhauli.

sources.title: Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation, City Disaster Management Plan 2024
sources.note: Printed pp. 7 and 10 identify Otto Königsberger as the modern city’s planner.

sources.title: Ahimanikya Satapathy, Bhubaneswar Fresco
sources.note: Photographs from February 2009. The mural artists and present condition of the paintings remain unverified.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
sources.note: Dates the pagoda to the 1970s, distinguishes the Ashokan edicts, and lists Bhubaneswar’s airport and railway station. Its popular account of Ashoka’s conversion should not be read as an eyewitness record.

sources.title: Odisha Crafts Museum, Kala Bhoomi catalogue, 2019
sources.note: Printed pp. 8–11 and 42–45: terracotta roof tiles and ikat collection examples. These are catalogue records, not confirmation of what is currently on display.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Cuisine & Culinary Trails
sources.note: Dalma is described as a preparation of lentils and vegetables; individual recipes vary.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Weather and Climate
sources.note: Recommends November–March for Bhubaneswar and places the rainy season in June–September. The newer city overview gives October–March. Both are broad seasonal guides, not forecasts.

sources.title: Visit Bhubaneswar: OTDC Panthanivas
sources.note: Municipal visitor listing for the Lewis Road property and its Odia-food restaurant. A planning lead, not an inspection or a promise of current service.

sources.title: Visit Bhubaneswar: Mukteswar Dance Festival
sources.note: Documents the setting’s association with Odissi. Check a dated organiser’s programme for the year of travel.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism: Tourist Offices
sources.note: Lists a Bhubaneswar office. Use the current directory to make enquiries; no response or referral is guaranteed.
